[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]bob ref create -f|--force[=reread|overwrite]: recapture a source [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]you already have[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A source that is already a reference can be captured again on [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]purpose. Bare -f adds a new <root>__vN reading linked to the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]earlier ones. -f overwrite recaptures a reference in place and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]keeps its path, id, and reading task. Before that, anything you [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]made in the old note is frozen into ref_history/. Without -f, a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]duplicate is refused before any fetch, with one clear message that [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]names the existing copies and the exact fix.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Reading families in the library read model[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]family[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]family: teach ref_library the note-local earlier: list, reading numbers,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and families. Doctor stops flagging families as duplicate_identity, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]find/show/resolve rank the newest reading first, list/show render vN [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]chips and earlier/later rows, and JSON grows additively; uses [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]hand-written fixtures only.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]One already-captured refusal, before parent resolution[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]refusal[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]refusal: route every duplicate site (URL dedupe, same-reference stem [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]walk, library PDF as TARGET, collections) through one renderer that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]lists every copy and prints several hint rows. Duplicate detection runs [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]before the missing -P error. -f semantics are unchanged.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The --force[=MODE] parser and bare -f reread[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]reread[dim] · [dim][/dim]after family, refusal[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]reread: turn -f into --force[=MODE], with adjacent-mode adoption and a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]stray-mode guard, and replace the bool with Option<ForceMode>. Ship [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reread end to end: the <root>__vN allocator, earlier: written at birth [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](inline and queued), the -vN block-id suffix, the 'Title (vN)' alias, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]-P/-t defaults from the family, hints, refusals, the reread: output [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]line, collections with an exact URL set, docs. overwrite parses but [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]refuses until the next phase.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]In-place overwrite of unannotated references[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]overwrite[dim] · [dim][/dim]after reread[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]overwrite: -f overwrite on any host, for references with no PDF [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]annotations. Includes rename-style preconditions, -N member selection, a[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]render-first locked transaction with a host-local intent marker and HEAD[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rollback, sidecar removal, and a frozen inert note in ref_history/ when [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]there is authored prose. Also earlier: carry-forward, recaptured:, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]success output, the overwrite refusal hints, and docs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Annotated overwrite on the Mac[/bold #D7AFFF]                                [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]annotated[dim] · [dim][/dim]after overwrite[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]annotated: overwrite references that carry highlights, image selections,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]or .assets/, on macOS only and only under [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]highlights.coordinate_pdf_writes. Rename the annotated PDF and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]assets into ref_history/, move inbound #^h- links to the frozen note, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]add the scan write-back guard, extend the acceptance runbook, and refuse[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with a hint on other hosts.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Decision record, glossary correction, and final docs pass[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]record[dim] · [dim][/dim]after annotated[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]record: write the accepted recapture decision record and correct the [/#D7D7AF]
